title: The reconstructed Tate objects and their normalized comparison maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\ell$ prime, $E=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf Q_\ell)$, $r$ normalized realization data at $X$ and $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization-records]. With the integral coefficient encoding and tensor powers of [lem-pur-condensed-tate-integral-comparison, def-pur-condensed-tate-twists], encode the strict positive finite tower over the completed integral coefficient ring. Define reconstructed as its single complex followed by the actual derived inverse limit [def-pur-completed-rlim-functor], and shiftedReconstructed by shift $[2d]$. Define derivedAugmentation by the constant-tower/derived-limit adjunction from the tensor projection cone. Define ambientRealization and scalarAdjunction by the recorded two coefficient extensions and their restrictions [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization-records]. Define balancedPower by the integral-to-closure unit and successor tensor equations, and derivedBalancedPower by its section encoding and single-functor comparison. Define HasCanonicalReductions by the induced finite-level projection isomorphisms. Finally define shiftedComparison from an unshifted comparison using the recorded realization and canonical commutation with shift. These are actual constructions; this definition asserts no invertibility of the augmentation or balanced transpose.
